title: Automatic payment retry on PSP failure
description:
Context: A temporary PSP outage (timeout, 5xx) fails the order outright today: customer sees an error, cart is abandoned, support tickets follow. The order service already distinguishes PSP decline from PSP error, so a legitimate retry is identifiable.
Reason: Payment errors were 38% of abandoned carts last quarter; the payments team estimates roughly a fifth are transient PSP failures. Support receives ~120 payment-failure tickets/month; halving that saves about 2 agent-days per month.
Scope: Automatic retry for PSP errors only. Out of scope: retries for declines, changes to the decline messaging, native apps.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment that failed due to a PSP error (not a decline), when the failure is handled, then the system retries the payment automatically without customer action.
Given a retried payment that succeeds or a failure that is a decline, when the outcome is known, then retries stop immediately.
Given retries exhausted, when the last attempt fails, then the customer sees the standard payment-failed page and the order remains recoverable from the cart.
Given any retried payment, when it completes (success or final failure), then the retry outcome is visible in the existing payments dashboard.
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
